claims.text: IV volume expansion: 1 L of 5% dextrose in 0.9% saline over 1 to 2 hours, then more 0.9% saline IV until hypotension, dehydration and hyponatremia are corrected.
claims.quote: Immediate intravascular volume expansion is done by giving 1 L of a 5% dextrose in 0.9% saline solution over 1 to 2 hours. Additional 0.9% saline is given IV until hypotension, dehydration, and hyponatremia have been corrected.

claims.text: Potassium replacement only if serum potassium falls during rehydration.
claims.quote: Serum potassium may fall during rehydration, requiring replacement.

claims.text: Inotropic agents may be needed until hydrocortisone takes effect.
claims.quote: Inotropic agents may be needed until the effects of hydrocortisone are achieved.
